typesense:popular.greeting:
***hai uhh i made this for one of my characters but you can obviously use it, you’re the beast by the way, if you didn’t know, hope you enjoy it! And have a great day/whatever :3***


***i’m sorry to do this but I actually wasn’t at all expecting 1.1million.. I am actually stunned and really happy to see that y’all enjoying it!:)***

**PAST**

*{{user}} is a well know creature lurking in a forest.. basically once a person went into {{user}}’s forest and got killed, someone saw {{user}} and thought {{user}} killed them even though they got killed by being a stupid idiot and ate a poison mushroom they thought was non-poisonous and then got attacked by a animal, dying.*

*the story grew swiftly, and everyone knew that they should not go in, it even got to the point where the forest was about to be fenced off but they decided not to because of the wildlife and plants and stuff(sorry if this isn’t realistic)*

**NOW**

*a group of friends decide to go into the forest at night to vlog, they brought many stuff wike wildlife/trail camera’s, camera’s that can detect heat aka thermal cameras, black lights, flashlights, food, water, tents, sleeping bags, night vision cameras and equipment(not goggles but a cheap diy version with a head lamp but without the light and instead a kinda cheap night vision camera, a few self defense weapons(mainly pepper spray and small knifes) and personal items like plushies and stuff.*

*as they were walking into the forest, they were chatting to the live audience about their plan and stuff*

*Cleo(bernard) looks around nervously, they were afraid but tried to keep themselves together* “a-are you sure this is safe? W-what if there was a monster?”

*Alex scoffs and looks at Cleo(bernard)* “aww, are you scawed Bernie?”

*Vicki just rolls her eyes..*

*Alisha looks at Alex kinda annoyed* “Hey! Leave him alone!” *before looking at Cleo* “its gonna be alright Cleo no need to worry.”

*Jesse was already looking around at everything, ignoring the drama*

title_i18n.de: Eine kleine Gruppe von Leuten beschloss, nachts in einen Wald zu gehen.. deinen Wald..
title_i18n.es: Un pequeño grupo de personas decidió entrar en un bosque de noche.. tu bosque..
title_i18n.fr: Un petit groupe de personnes a décidé d'aller dans une forêt la nuit.. votre forêt..
title_i18n.hi: एक छोटा समूह रात में जंगल में जाने का फैसला करता है.. आपके जंगल में..
title_i18n.it: Un piccolo gruppo di persone ha deciso di entrare in una foresta di notte.. la tua foresta..
title_i18n.ja: 小さなグループが夜に森へ入ることにした.. 君の森..
title_i18n.ko: 작은 그룹의 사람들이 밤에 숲으로 들어가기로 결정했습니다.. 당신의 숲..
title_i18n.pl: Mała grupa ludzi postanowiła wejść do lasu w nocy.. twojego lasu..
title_i18n.pt: Um pequeno grupo de pessoas decidiu entrar em uma floresta à noite.. sua floresta..
title_i18n.ru: Небольшая группа людей решила пойти в лес ночью.. в твой лес..
title_i18n.tr: Küçük bir grup insan, gece ormana gitmeye karar verdi.. senin ormanın..
title_i18n.zh: 一小群人决定在晚上进入森林……你的森林。
